events.info: All tickets are mobile entry only. Paper tickets are not available. All gates will open 60 minutes prior to kick. Tickets in the following sections are required to enter through the following gates: Gate D: Suites & West Club (sections 13-17, 113-117 ONLY) Gate A & C: All other sections Tickets in the West Club (sections 13-17, 113-117 ONLY) include select complimentary food and beverage. Pride Supporters Section - General admission safe-standing section, no assigned locations. Instead of seats, each row has a rail that provides safety as well as a cup holder for drinks. When in the home supporter section, always wear purple! If purple isn't your thing, then alternate colors are black, gray or white. Opposing colors of any team, not just the one playing, and/or non-Orlando Pride team apparel, will not be allowed into the sections.
events.pleaseNote: *Dogs only permitted in the Supporter Section* A dog?friendly matchday inviting fans and their leashed pets to the stadium. The event will incorporate pet?focused activities in a family?friendly environment. CLEAR BAG POLICY - To provide a safer environment for the public and expedite guest entry into the stadium, Inter&Co Stadium policy limits and restricts the size and type of bags that are permitted into the stadium during Inter&Co Stadium events and any other in-stadium public event. The Club encourage guests not to bring any bags, however the following will be permitted: one clear bag no larger than 12" x 6" x 12" OR a one-gallon clear freezer bag. Guests may carry a small clutch bag or purse no larger than 6.5" x 4.5", with or without a strap.
